observations.title: Disable unwanted item identities
observations.player_action: An administrator lists exact IDs or supported regular expressions in the Item Obliterator configuration.
observations.outcome: Full removal can cover inventories, drops, creative tabs, trades, recipes and recipe viewers.
conditions: An invalid or absent ID does nothing; a successful parse is not proof the intended item matched.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Disabled items are not valid quest rewards or inventory goals. Confirm effective blacklist/NBT patterns and recipe presence in installed config before using any candidate.

observations.title: Disable only an interaction or recipe

observations.outcome: A selective rule can preserve the item while removing the specified use or variants.

observations.player_action: Compare server and client configurations when a removed item remains visible in JEI.
observations.outcome: Server-only behavior cannot supply the client-side creative/JEI hiding advertised when both sides participate.
